name: US–China / Taiwan
summary: Taiwan tracked 6 Chinese military aircraft and 12 naval ships around the island in the 24 hours to 23 Nov
state: Taiwan's defence ministry tracked six Chinese military aircraft sorties and 12 naval ships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 06:00 on 23 Nov; five of the sorties crossed the median line into the south-western and eastern ADIZ (Taiwan MND). On 21 Nov it reported two aircraft, six naval vessels and four balloons, with November totals passing 230 aircraft (Taiwan News). Activity is below the month's one-day high of 49 aircraft; no blockade, clash or severed channel was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Tension in the Taiwan Strait mainly affects shipping, air routes and electronics supply chains. Travellers to Taiwan should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Sustained PLA activity around Taiwan, no blockade or clash = Watch

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
